depiction.primary_object: outlined head and shoulders bust of a single person
modifiers: horizontal minus sign to the right
depiction.composition: single object with right-side modifier, front view

readings.meaning: remove a user, member, or contact
revoke someone's access or offboard a departing employee
delete or deactivate a user account or profile
unfollow, unfriend, or kick someone from a group

ambiguity: Opposite in meaning to the person-with-plus-sign icon; at tiny sizes the short horizontal bar can also resemble a pencil or dash next to a user.

reasoning: Shows a person bust paired with a minus sign, universally understood as removing a user, contact, member, or account. It fits concrete admin, tech, work offboarding, and household tasks about revoking access, deleting profiles, or taking people off shared plans, while remaining distinct from add-user (+).

readings.meaning: offboard an employee or revoke access
